Question: Consortium roles: Which organizations participate in the ALPINE project, what role does each play (coordinator, materials, manufacturing, pilot operation), and which agency funds it?

MATCH (p:Project {name: 'ALPINE'})<-[r:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(o:Organization)
OPTIONAL MATCH (agency:FundingAgency)-[f:FUNDS]->(p)
RETURN o.name AS organization,
       [l IN labels(o) WHERE l <> 'Organization'][0] AS org_type,
       r.role AS role,
       r.contribution AS contribution,
       agency.name AS funded_by,
       f.amount AS grant_amount,
       f.currency AS currency
ORDER BY CASE r.role WHEN 'coordinator' THEN 0 WHEN 'materials' THEN 1
                     WHEN 'manufacturing' THEN 2 WHEN 'pilot operation' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END

Question: Publication output: For each project, list its publications together with the authors and their affiliations.

MATCH (proj:Project)<-[:RESULT_OF]-(pub:Publication)<-[a:AUTHORED]-(per:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (per)-[aff:AFFILIATED_WITH]->(org:Organization)
  WHERE aff.type IN ['employment', 'study']
    AND coalesce(aff.start_year, 0) <= pub.year
    AND coalesce(aff.end_year, 9999) >= pub.year
WITH proj, pub, a.position AS pos, per, collect(org.name) AS orgs
ORDER BY proj.name, pub.year, pub.title, pos
WITH proj, pub,
     collect(per.name + ' (' + reduce(s = '', o IN orgs | s + CASE WHEN s = '' THEN '' ELSE ', ' END + o) + ')') AS authors

       pub.title AS publication,
       pub.year AS year,

Question: Mobility: Which researchers have been affiliated with more than one organization (employment or study), and what was the direction of each move?
Cypher Query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[a:AFFILIATED_WITH]->(o:Organization)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(c:Country)
WHERE a.type IN ['employment', 'study']
WITH p, a, o, c
ORDER BY a.current, coalesce(a.start_year, a.end_year)
WITH p, collect({org: o.name, type: a.type, position: a.position, start: a.start_year, end: a.end_year,
                 country: c.name,
                 sector: CASE WHEN o:Company THEN 'industry' WHEN o:Utility THEN 'utility' ELSE 'academia' END}) AS hist
WHERE size(hist) > 1
UNWIND range(0, size(hist) - 2) AS i
WITH p, hist[i] AS f, hist[i + 1] AS t
RETURN p.name AS researcher,
       f.org + ' (' + f.type + ', ' + f.position + ')' AS moved_from,
       t.org + ' (' + t.type + ', ' + t.position + ')' AS moved_to,
       coalesce(t.start, f.end) AS year_of_move,
       f.sector + ' -> ' + t.sector AS sector_direction,
       f.country + ' -> ' + t.country AS geographic_direction
ORDER BY year_of_move, researcher

Question: Collaboration horizon: Starting from the Halvorsen Institute of Technology, which organizations are reachable within two project-collaboration hops, and through which projects?
Cypher Query:
MATCH path = (start:Organization {name: 'Halvorsen Institute of Technology'})
             ((:Organization)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(:Project)<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(:Organization)){1,2}
             (target:Organization)
WITH start, target, path, nodes(path) AS ns
WHERE target <> start
  AND all(n IN ns WHERE size([m IN ns WHERE m = n]) = 1)
WITH target, length(path) / 2 AS hops,
     reduce(s = head(ns).name, n IN tail(ns) |
            s + CASE WHEN n:Project THEN ' -[' + n.name + ']-> ' ELSE n.name END) AS route
WITH target, min(hops) AS min_hops, collect({hops: hops, route: route}) AS routes
RETURN target.name AS organization,
       min_hops AS hops,
       [r IN routes WHERE r.hops = min_hops | r.route] AS via
ORDER BY hops, organization

2. organization: Lumen Storage Systems; hops: 1; via: [Halvorsen Institute of Technology -[ALPINE]-> Lumen Storage Systems]
